hooks.command: git config user.email | grep -q noreply || echo "WARN: git email not noreply — push will fail GH007"; [ -d backend/.venv ] || echo "WARN: no backend/.venv in this worktree"

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py|*.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) awk 'END{if(NR>300) print FILENAME": "NR" lines — exceeds 300-line style gate"}' "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
